'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[November 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***A rocket attack on residential areas in the [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] capital [[Kabul]] kills at least eight people and injures 31 others. The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-55026991 (BBC News)]
**[[Afghanistan–United States relations]], [[Afghan peace process]]
***[[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] meets with the [[Taliban]] and the [[Politics of Afghanistan|Afghanistan government]] in [[Doha, Qatar]] to negotiate a peace deal. [https://www.columbian.com/news/2020/nov/21/islamic-state-attack-hits-afghan-capital-pompeo-joins-peace-talks/ (''The Columbian'')] 
*[[Tigray conflict]]
**[[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Federal troops]] capture the city of [[Adigrat]] near the [[Eritrea]]n border in [[Ethiopia]]'s [[Tigray Region]]. [[Ethiopia]]n government forces are now within 116 km (72 miles) of the heavily defended Tigrayan capital [[Mekelle]]. The [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]]  (TPLF) says Adigrat has experienced "heavy bombardment", but does not confirm the loss of the city. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/21/ethiopia-denies-talks-on-tigray-region-growing-conflict (Al Jazeera)]
**Ethiopia rejects the [[African Union]]'s offer to mediate an end to the conflict. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/rest-of-africa/ethiopia-rejects-au-mediation-offer-3205612 (''The East African'')]
**The TPLF report the deaths of nine civilians during the military assault on Adigrat. The Ethiopian government has denied targeting civilians and both the government and military could not be reached for comment. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict-casualties/tigray-rebels-say-nine-civilians-killed-in-ethiopian-attack-idUSKBN2810F1?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Maine]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New Hampshire]]
******[[Massachusetts]] announces that they will remove [[New Hampshire]] and [[Maine]] from their low-risk travel list for contracting COVID-19. Individuals returning to Massachusetts from those states will be required to fill out a travel form, quarantine, or present a negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test]]. [https://www.bostonglobe.com/2020/11/21/nation/new-hampshire-maine-removed-low-risk-travel-list-contracting-covid-19/ (''The Boston Globe'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] reports 15,442 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began as curfew begins in most counties. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-11-21/california-reports-record-15-442-new-coronavirus-cases (Bloomberg)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] surpasses 300,000 confirmed cases of COVID-19. [https://www.clickondetroit.com/health/2020/11/21/michigan-coronavirus-cases-up-to-302705-death-toll-now-at-8478/ (WDIV-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mississippi]]
*****[[Mississippi]] reports a new daily record of 1,972 cases, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 142,401. [https://www.clarionledger.com/story/news/local/2020/11/21/covid-19-mississippi-highest-cases-1-971-on-nov-21/6373033002/ (''Clarion Ledger'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
*****[[New Jersey]] surpasses 300,000 cases after reporting a new daily record of 4,679 cases. [https://www.northjersey.com/story/news/2020/11/21/nj-sees-record-number-covid-cases-ahead-thanksgiving-week/6375131002/ (Northjersey.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oregon]]
*****[[Oregon]] reports a record 1,509 new cases, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 63,688. [https://katu.com/news/local/oregon-reports-more-than-1500-coronavirus-cases-breaking-another-daily-record (KATU-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
*****[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Kelly Loeffler]] is expected to quarantine after testing positive for COVID-19 and receiving an inconclusive result. [https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/527050-loeffler-isolating-after-possible-covid-19-infection (''The Hill'')]
****The [[United States]] surpasses 12 million cases of COVID-19, just six days after surpassing 11 million cases. New cases reach record highs in recent days, with more than 200,000 cases being reported. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/u-s-records-over-12-million-cases-coronavirus-n1248511 (NBC News)] [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2020/11/21/937615700/u-s-passes-12-million-confirmed-coronavirus-cases (NPR)]
****The U.S. [[Food and Drug Administration]] grants an [[emergency use authorization]] for [[Regeneron Pharmaceuticals]]' antibody cocktail to treat COVID-19 patients. The cocktail was previously given to President [[Donald Trump]] during his hospitalization for COVID-19 last month. [https://www.axios.com/fda-emergency-use-regeneron-antibody-covid-trump-474b7fcc-7259-4259-9a6d-2e1f4f2fa30f.html (Axios)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Brunswick]]
*****[[New Brunswick]] reports 23 new cases in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record since the [[pandemic]] began as [[Premier of New Brunswick|Premier]] [[Blaine Higgs]] warns that tighter restrictions will be rolled out if the increase in cases continues. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/new-brunswick/new-brunswick-officials-to-provide-update-on-two-regional-outbreaks-1.5811335 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 1,588 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/ontario-breaks-previous-record-with-more-than-1-500-new-cases-of-covid-19-reported-1.5199163 (CFTO-DT)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saskatchewan]]
*****[[Saskatchewan]] reports 439 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. The province now has 6,237 total confirmed cases. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7476973/saskatchewan-coronavirus-cases-nov-21-covid-19/ (Global News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] reports a record 539 new cases in the past 24 hours, according to a statement from the [[Tokyo Metropolitan Government|metropolitan government]], bringing the cumulative total since the pandemic began to 37,317 cases. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20201121_16/ (NHK World)]
****Due to rising COVID-19 cases across the country, [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Yoshihide Suga]] announces the suspension of the [[government of Japan|government]]-promoted "Go To Travel" campaign in areas with high infection rates. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/11/21/national/go-to-travel-coronavirus-surge/ (''The Japan Times'')]
****[[Japan]] reports a record of more than 2,500 new cases, according to official figures released by the government. It is the fourth time that Japan has reported a record number of cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.efe.com/efe/english/portada/japan-suspends-subsidized-domestic-travel-scheme-amid-soaring-infections/50000260-4400377?utm_source=wwwefecom&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss (EFE)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] imposes tougher restrictions in [[Tehran]] and other cities as the country battles a third wave of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://uk.mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/idUKKBN2810GI (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia|Senior Minister]] [[Ismail Sabri Yaakob]] announces that the [[Government of Malaysia|government]] will lift the [[2020 Malaysia movement control order|conditional movement control order]] (CMCO) in [[Kedah]], [[Melaka]], [[Terengganu]] and [[Johor]] tomorrow but will place [[Kelantan]] under the CMCO until December 6. He also announces that foreign workers in some regions will have to undergo mandatory [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 swab test]]s. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2020/11/21/kelantan-to-be-placed-under-cmco (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] reports the highest single-day total for both daily cases and deaths since mid-July, when 2,843 new cases and 47 new deaths are reported in the last 24 hours. This brings the cumulative number of cases to 371,508 and the nationwide death toll to 7,603. [https://nation.com.pk/21-Nov-2020/pakistan-reports-2-843-new-coronavirus-cases (''The Nation'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[South Korea]] in the last 24 hours reaches a three-month high of 386. The country now has 30,403 total cases and more than 500 total deaths, according to data from the [[Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201121000852315?section=national/national (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] surpasses 7,000 total deaths from COVID-19. [https://english.radio.cz/coronavirus-death-toll-doubles-end-october-8700783 (Radio Prague International)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 24,822 new cases and 467 deaths in the last 24 hours, bringing the number of cases to 2,064,748 and the death toll to 35,778. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/russia-registers-new-single-day-record-of-24822-covid-cases-in-24-hours-response-center/articleshow/79337735.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion]]
****Mourners pay respects to the former head of the [[Serbian Orthodox Church]] [[Irinej|Patriarch Irinej]] in [[Belgrade]] following his death due to COVID-19. Many mourners did not wear [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|face masks]] or practice [[social distancing]], and some kissed the glass shield that was covering the patriarch's body despite warnings from the [[Government of Serbia|Serbian government]] and epidemiologists. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-serbia-coronavirus-pandemic-belgrade-3ab208852c3911cb54400c58297a0c30  (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a new record of 5,532 new cases in the last 24 hours, surpassing the previous record set in April. The country now has 440,805 total confirmed cases since the pandemic began as a curfew takes effect. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/turkey-reports-record-daily-number-covid-19-patients-74336913 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a new single-day record of 14,580 cases, bringing the nationwide total to 612,665 cases. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/covid-19-in-ukraine-14580-new-cases-215-new-deaths-319539-active-cases.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
****[[Chile]] surpasses 20,000 total deaths from COVID-19, including suspected and confirmed cases. [https://www.elmostrador.cl/destacado/2020/11/21/deis-chile-supero-los-20-000-fallecidos-por-covid-19-entre-confirmados-y-probables-y-casos-activos-siguen-concentrados-en-el-sur/ (''El Mostrador'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
*****[[Singapore]] and [[Hong Kong]] postpone their air travel bubble agreement for two weeks amid a rise in COVID-19 cases in Hong Kong, which reported 43 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/11/21/singapore-hong-kong-travel-bubble-continues-as-hong-kong-covid-cases-rise.html (CNBC)]
**[[2020 G20 Riyadh summit]]
***World leaders at the virtual [[G20]] summit in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]], call for a united response to the COVID-19 pandemic and discuss the global economic crises and climate change. [https://www.inquirer.com/news/nation-world/g20-summit-begins-covid-19-economic-crisis-climate-change-20201121.html (''The Philadelphia Inquirer'')]
***[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] tells [[G20]] leaders that his [[Russia|country]] is ready to provide their [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine to other countries who need it. [https://www.reuters.com/article/g20-saudi-russia/russia-ready-to-provide-other-countries-with-sputnik-v-coronavirus-vaccine-says-putin-idUSR4N2HI030 (Reuters)]
*[[Lobsang Sangay]], the leader of the exiled [[Central Tibetan Administration]], visits the [[White House]], marking their first meeting in 60 years. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/527021-tibetan-political-leader-makes-visit-to-white-house-for-first-time-in (''The Hill'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Baabda prison escape]]
**Sixty-nine [[Prison escape|inmates escape]] from a prison in [[Baabda District]], [[Lebanon]]. Five of them are killed in a [[car crash]] while being pursued by security forces. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-11-21/more-than-60-prisoners-escape-lebanese-jail-say-security-sources (''U.S. News'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 Georgian parliamentary election]]
**The second round of [[Elections in Georgia (country)|parliamentary elections]] is held in [[Georgia (Country)|Georgia]]. After the first round in late October caused controversy, the political opposition called to boycott the run-off votes, leaving the candidates of the ruling [[Georgian Dream]] to run uncontested. [https://menafn.com/1101161960/Second-round-of-parliamentary-elections-ongoing-in-Georgia (MENAFN)]
*[[2020 Guatemalan protests]]
**More than 7,000 people gather in [[Guatemala City]] to protest the recent budget bill. The National Congress building is also set on fire. [https://apnews.com/article/legislature-health-media-social-media-coronavirus-pandemic-6124c886df3e58dee7e40da2a803e688 (AP)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**A [[United States federal judge|federal judge]] dismisses a [[Post-election lawsuits related to the 2020 U.S. presidential election|lawsuit]] filed by [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign|re-election campaign]] to block the certification of [[Pennsylvania]]'s election results, saying it was "an attempt to violate the Constitution". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/us-judge-dismisses-trump-campaign-lawsuit-in-pa/2020/11/21/cc097fbe-2c50-11eb-9b14-ad872157ebc9_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Copernicus Programme]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches the [[European Space Agency]]'s [[Satellite geodesy#Altimetry|satellite altimeter]] [[Copernicus Sentinel-6]] from [[Vandenberg Air Force Base]]. The satellite will monitor global [[Sea level rise|sea levels]] with high accuracy, enhance [[weather forecasting]], and provide detailed information on ocean currents to support ship navigation near coastlines. [https://www.nasa.gov/press-release/nasa-us-and-european-partners-launch-mission-to-monitor-global-ocean (NASA.gov)]
